# Clay and Bricks Pvt Ltd

> Odisha's premier turnkey architectural design studio, luxury interior contractor, and civil construction firm based in Bhubaneswar. Delivering single-point accountability, 3D digital twins, factory-grade millwork, and a 10-year structural warranty across residential estates, duplex villas, and commercial spaces.

Clay and Bricks Pvt Ltd is an integrated architecture and construction firm headquartered in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The studio eliminates the traditional friction between architects, civil contractors, and carpentry teams by taking complete turnkey responsibility from raw groundbreak to final furnish.

- **Headquarters**: Plot No. 400/3226/6837, Lane 1, Mahadev Nagar, Jharpada, Bhubaneswar, Odisha — 751006, India
- **Phone**: +91 88673 55661
- **Email**: hi.clayandbricks@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://clayandbricks.com
- **Office Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM IST (Consultations by Appointment)

## Core Capabilities & Specializations

- **Turnkey Interior Architecture**: Bespoke spatial planning, Italian marble installation (Statuario, Botticino), factory-made modular cabinetry, and acoustic ceiling grids.
- **Structural Civil Construction**: Earthquake-resistant RCC frame casting (IS 456 / IS 1893 compliant), deep foundation engineering, and multi-layer waterproofing under licensed civil engineers.
- **Precision 3D Digital Twins**: Millimeter-accurate raytraced architectural models simulating solar angles, lux levels, and exact material reflections before construction commences.
- **Architectural & Elevation Design**: Modern villa elevation, climate-adaptive vernacular facades (Khandolite stone & laterite masonry), and statutory BDA/BMC sanction drawings.
- **Quality & Warranty Guarantee**: 400-point rigorous site inspection protocol and an industry-leading 10-Year Structural Integrity Warranty.

## Specialized Architectural & Interior Services

- [Luxury Interior Design Bhubaneswar](https://clayandbricks.com/services/interior-design-bhubaneswar): Full-scope interior design, bespoke furniture, imported marble, and turnkey residential styling in Bhubaneswar.
- [Turnkey Civil Construction Bhubaneswar](https://clayandbricks.com/services/civil-construction-bhubaneswar): End-to-end house construction, RCC framing, deep piling, and structural engineering with a 10-year warranty.
- [Modular Kitchen Design Bhubaneswar](https://clayandbricks.com/services/modular-kitchen-bhubaneswar): Precision German-hardware modular kitchens, marine-grade BWP ply, quartz countertops, and Blum/Hettich fittings.
- [Architectural Design & Planning](https://clayandbricks.com/services/architectural-design-bhubaneswar): Contemporary villa elevations, floor plans, structural drafting, and BDA/BMC statutory approval documentation.
- [Duplex Villa Interior Design](https://clayandbricks.com/services/duplex-interior-design): Specialized double-height living room architecture, bespoke floating staircases, and multi-generational spatial zoning.
- [Commercial Interior Design](https://clayandbricks.com/services/commercial-interior-design): High-performance corporate offices, boutique retail flagships, acoustic timber wall paneling, and executive suites.

## Featured Project Case Studies & Works

- [Luxury Villa, Shree Vihar](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/luxury-villa-shree-vihar): 9,500 sq ft multi-generational estate in Shree Vihar, Bhubaneswar featuring modular sage cabinetry, fluted glass partitions, and Italian marble.
- [3 BHK Luxury Apartment, Laxmi Imperial](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/3-bhk-apartment-laxmi-imperial): 2,150 sq ft modern residence at Laxmi Imperial, Bhubaneswar featuring warm wood veneer fluted walls, custom vitrines, and cove illumination.
- [Bibhu Babu's Villa](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/bibhu-babu-villa): 4,800 sq ft contemporary duplex villa in Patharagadia, Bhubaneswar uniting RCC structural engineering and bespoke interior finishing.
- [Laterite Villa](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/laterite-villa): 6,200 sq ft double-height private estate in Patia, Bhubaneswar blending raw Odisha laterite stone with polished concrete.
- [Brass & Noir Kitchen](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/brass-noir-kitchen): 920 sq ft luxury modular kitchen in Sahid Nagar, Bhubaneswar featuring antique brass hardware, severe charcoal palette, and waterfall Calacatta marble island.
- [Terracotta Sanctuary](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/terracotta-sanctuary): 840 sq ft master suite in Nayapalli, Bhubaneswar featuring hand-troweled terracotta plaster inspired by the sun temple walls of Konark.
- [Stone Office, Janpath](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/stone-office-janpath): 3,800 sq ft corporate office on Janpath, Bhubaneswar featuring fluted sandstone wall panels and monolithic hand-carved stone boardroom desk.
- [Forest Pool Villa](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/forest-pool-villa): 8,400 sq ft pavilion residence in Chandaka, Bhubaneswar dissolving into the forest canopy with an infinity basalt pool and laterite plinth.
- [Konark Boutique Hotel](https://clayandbricks.com/projects/konark-boutique-hotel): 12,000 sq ft luxury boutique hotel on Puri Road, Bhubaneswar with double-height mandapa lobby, hand-carved sandstone screens, and gold leaf ceilings.
